notes: The rider controls their own speed and the course terminates at the base village, which is the genre note's exact test for Racing over Infinite Runner, and the answer settled the endless-feeling wording as one authored descent from summit to village, so route-point-to-point rather than a runner lane. Downhill Descent is the preset built for this, but checkpoint-respawn was dropped because the prompt says a wipeout ends the run outright, so there is no recovery point to place; startpoint-line and trigger-finish were added for the summit gate and the village finish the preset leaves unstated. Green, blue and black are branching lines down the same mountain by the second answer, so this is one continuous course with alternate risk routes and stays off P4, and terrain-relief carries the alpine pitch as tiered only, since cliff drops, banked walls and cat-track gaps are relief with nothing overhanging. Nothing in the option set expresses a terrain park, so recording it here: kickers, boxes, rails and a halfpipe section on the built line, powder pockets and tree runs as the off-piste shortcuts, and chunk-stitched authoring of the descent.
